subject: balcony_open
note: Worked example 4 (M6): the three gaps the blind builder seats reported, in one file. `balcony` repeats twice up the face, and ONE authored `rail` lands on EVERY balcony — per-instance children are the default in M6, so nothing has to be said for it to happen (`attach.instance: 0` is how you ask for the anchor only, as railing_open's top rail does). The railing is `railing_open` — bottom rail, six posts, top rail, no infill web — which is authorable at all only because `alignU` lets the top rail butt its edge to a point on the face's u axis.
